title: Bike tyre pumped, gauge visible
description: Pump a bicycle tyre and show the pressure: tyre inflated, gauge reading visible, both wheels seated, bike stable.

criteria.label: Tyre is inflated and a pressure gauge reading is visible
Both wheels look correctly seated and undamaged
Bike is upright and stable on the ground

notes: MANUAL §9.5 "tyre pumped (gauge visible)". Keep the pump and gauge in the AFTER frame; same wheel visible in the BEFORE frame.
